3. Applicant-Smt. Salma, who is the first informant, has approached this Court by means of present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. with the following prayer:
"It is, therefore most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow the present Application and direct the learned court below to expedite the proceeding of the Session Trial No. 1377 of 2023 (State Vs. Naushad and Smt. Salma vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13601390/
1 another), Under Section 366, 376 I.P.C., Police Station Purkaji, District Muzaffar Nagar arising out of Case Crime No. 32 of 2022, pending before the court of Session Judge, Muzaffar Nagar, within stipulated period, otherwise the applicant shall suffer irreparable loss and injury.

entities.text: State Vs. Naushad and Smt. Salma vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: court of Session Judge, Muzaffar Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: And/or to pass such other and further order or direction which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case in the interest of justice."
4. On the matter being taken up, the learned A.G.A. has opposed present application with reference to the order sheet.

According to the learned A.G.A. when prosecution witness of fact i.e. P.W.-1 is herself not appearing before court below for her cross-examination, the prayer prayed for by manes of present application by first informant, Smt. Salma (P.W.-1) is misconceived.
5. When confronted with above, the learned counsel for applicant fairly submits that she be permitted to withdraw the present application.
6. Learned A.G.A. representing State-opposite party-1, has no objection to the prayer made by the learned counsel for applicant.
7. In view of above, present application is accordingly dismissed as withdrawn.
8. Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
